$description: Southville Running Club brand tokens. A MIRROR of styles/tokens.css, which is canonical and is what ships; tests/brand.test.ts fails if the two disagree. This file exists so the palette can be diffed against bindalshah/src-race-timing's design-tokens.json, which uses this same format, and imported into Figma (Tokens Studio) without anybody retyping a hex code.

green.$description: The brand green, read off the live club site's header band on 16 August 2026. AWAITING COMMITTEE CONFIRMATION. Surfaces and the logo only: 3.44:1 on the light page, below the 4.5:1 body-text floor. WCAG sets no contrast floor for a logotype, which is what lets the wordmark be this exact value.

greenText.$description: The brand green at a lightness that can be read. Hue and saturation held. 8.74:1 on the light page, 7.99:1 on the banner band, 8.90:1 for white on it.

greenTextDark.$description: The same, for the dark scheme. 9.97:1 on the dark page, 8.19:1 on the dark banner band.

ink.$description: Body text. 17.10:1. Kept rather than moved to the timing app's #2C2C2C, which is 13.72:1 — still AAA, but strictly worse.

slate.$description: Muted text. ADOPTED from the timing app's color.slate: 7.39:1 against this repository's previous #58585D at 6.95:1, an upgrade from AA to AAA.

slateDark.$description: Muted text on the dark page, 7.72:1. Not a lightened slate: a slate-hued grey at this lightness measures 7.00:1, so matching the hue would cost contrast for tidiness.

error.$description: 7.28:1. The timing app's color.danger (#E53935) is deliberately REFUSED: 4.15:1 here, which is large-text-only and would put failing error text on the form that asks people for money.

band.$description: The site banner band. A pale tint of the brand hue. Ink on it is 15.62:1.

bandDark.$description: The site banner band, dark scheme.

font.$description: Halyard Display is what the live club site uses and is NOT here: it is an Adobe Fonts webfont under a kit tied to the Squarespace domain and cannot be served from Cloudflare without its own licence. bindalshah/src-race-timing records the same constraint. Inter and JetBrains Mono are already vendored at apps/main/public/fonts with their OFL licences, and are the same two faces the timing app's tokens name.

body.value: "Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

mono.value: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

radius.$description: The same values bindalshah/src-race-timing carries as radius.button and radius.card, and the same ones nn-theme.css independently landed on as --nn-r-btn and --nn-r-card.

targetTextRatio.$description: This repository targets AAA for text rather than the AA floor. Every derived colour above was found by holding hue and saturation and moving lightness until it cleared 7:1 on the surface it is used on.

logo.$description: The wordmark is packages/shared/src/brand.ts (geometry) and apps/main/public/logo.svg (the standalone asset). It has no colour of its own — it is filled with currentColor and takes the colour of whatever renders it.
